subject: Implementation kickoff: MAP + 3-phase timeline
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimblecare.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation kickoff — aligning on MAP & timeline

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We want to move quickly but carefully: leadership has asked for a short, 3-phase implementation plan and a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we can share with stakeholders. High-level asks from our side:

- Phase 1 (Pilot): limited keys, verification tests, 2-week smoke run.
- Phase 2 (Expanded): UAT + integration with our workflows, 4 weeks.
- Phase 3 (Go-live): cutover, monitoring, SLA acceptance.

Can you and your CS lead put together a MAP that maps owners, dates, acceptance criteria, and blockers? I can share internal availability — Rajiv (cc’d) will handle procurement timing.

Would appreciate a draft by Friday so we can review with Ops.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
PM, Integrations
NimbleCare Health

[Attachment: initial_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — aligning on MAP & timeline

Hi Emily — thanks, and great to hear leadership wants to proceed. I’ve sketched a 3-phase MAP (attached) with owners and tentative dates based on our typical cadence. Notes up top:

- Owners: Monica (CS lead) will run pilot success criteria, Jordan will lead onboarding tasks and coordinate engineering handoffs.
- Tentative dates: Pilot kickoff Oct 27 — Pilot complete Nov 10; UAT Nov 11–Dec 8; Go-live target Dec 15. These are placeholders pending your procurement window.
- Acceptance criteria: I added an initial list (latency targets, error tolerance, key telemetry) but Monica will formalize.

Next actions: Monica and Jordan, can you review the attached MAP and sprint calendar and add owner-level tasks + durations? Emily/Rajiv — if procurement/whitelisting needs specific lead times, flag them and we’ll weave them into dates.

Attachments: nimblecare_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx), initial_sprint_calendar.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@nimblecare.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Implementation kickoff — aligning on MAP & timeline

Thanks for the draft, Mateo. I reviewed the MAP and added a task-level split in the spreadsheet. High-level edits and asks below:

- Acceptance criteria (to be finalized):
  • Pilot: < 100ms median p95 on dev dataset; no data exfil events; runbook validated.
  • UAT: integrations tested end-to-end with 95% of test cases green; doced rollback plan.
  • Go-live: production error rate < 0.5% over 72-hour burn-in, monitoring alerts setup and an on-call rotation.

- Dependencies: procurement needs a signed SOW + PO — Rajiv, please confirm estimated PO submission date.
- Risks: tokenization mismatch in one of your parsers — Jordan, can you own a short spec for required input normalization?
- People: I’ll own pilot validation and acceptance sign-off. Jordan will run engineer coordination during UAT. Mateo — I’ll need an ops contact for KV-cache tuning during pilot (if you have an ops engineer, please loop them in).

I attached the acceptance criteria doc that I propose we adopt as the single source of truth.

Attachments: acceptance_criteria.md (md)

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (510) 555-0148

1) Procurement: Rajiv confirms PO can be submitted by Nov 1 if we receive an SOW this week.
2) Kickoff: can we schedule a 60-min kickoff for Oct 26 to walk through the MAP and confirm owners? Preferably 9–11am PT.

I’m happy to take the kickoff invite once you propose a slot. Also shared the MAP folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d_nimblecare-MAP-v1 — I uploaded our internal integration checklist to that folder.

Next steps (agreed):
- Mateo to update MAP with Monica/Jordan inputs and resend by EOD Oct 23.

- Rajiv to proceed with PO timeline Nov 1 pending SOW.
- Schedule kickoff Oct 26 09:30 PT (tentative).
